formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Once anyone submits the signed permit before the deadline, the owner's DAI allowance for the spender is set to exactly `value`. It replaces any earlier allowance rather than adding to it.
The spender can then move up to `value` DAI from the owner with transferFrom or burn. If `value` is type(uint256).max, the allowance never goes down as it is spent.
The owner's permit nonce goes up by one, so any other signed permit that uses the same nonce stops working.
formats.shown: The intent says "Authorize spending of tokens". The fields show the spender as a raw address, the maximum amount in DAI ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or above), the expiry date and the owner. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line names no token, amount or spender.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats.Permit: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens" and no interpolatedIntent. Case 0 shows the intent "Authorize spending of tokens", with 2500 DAI and spender 0xE592…1564 only in the fields.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value} until {deadline}".
